arguments.sql:
SELECT a.alignment, COUNT(*) AS heroes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_ids,
       COUNT(p.id) AS matched_publishers, COUNT(p.publisher_name) AS nonnull_names,
       SUM(p.publisher_name = '') AS blank_names,
       SUM(p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS dc
FROM main.superhero AS s
LEFT JOIN main.alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
LEFT JOIN main.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
GROUP BY a.alignment

SELECT COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM main.superhero AS s
JOIN main.alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN main.publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND p.publisher_name <> 'DC Comics'
LIMIT 1
